name: Housing Sales
source: HM Land Registry, compiled by the Greater London Authority
file: housing_sales_borough.csv, saved from housing-sales-borough.csv and otherwise unchanged
covers: Homes sold each calendar year, January 1995 to December 2014
rows: 33 London boroughs (including the City of London), Inner and Outer London, 9 English regions, England, Wales, and England and Wales
excludes: Sales below market value (for example Right to Buy), sales under £1,000 and sales over £20m
